bwrap: Can't mount proc on <path>: Operation not permitted

finding: Masking/overmounts on the enclosing procfs prevented nested procfs mount. A fresh nosuid,nodev,noexec procfs inside the already private PID/mount namespace permits the unchanged inner bwrap. Preserving a capability bounding set alone did not fix the refusal.
invariants: Runtime/build target remains uid1001, all capability sets including bounds zero, NoNewPrivs1, source/filesystem read-only, only owned scratch writable, loopback-only network. Only the trusted enclosing setup mounts procfs before dropping UID/caps; no host sysctl/AppArmor/ruleset change.
